description_zh: 调用ModifyDtsJob接口修改同步任务
kebab_example: aliyun dts modify-dts-job --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --dts-instance-id dtsbi6e22ay2430000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyDtsJob

parameters.help_en: The region where the instance resides. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141033.html
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The instance ID of the data synchronization instance
parameters.name: dts_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies the synchronization direction. Valid values:
Forward: forward synchronization.
Reverse: reverse synchronization.

Default value: Forward.
This parameter is required only when the synchronization topology of the data synchronization instance is two-way synchronization
parameters.help_zh:
指定同步方向，取值：
Forward：正向。
Reverse：反向。

默认取值为Forward。
只有当数据同步实例的同步拓扑为双向同步时，才需要传入本参数
parameters.name: synchronization_direction

parameters.help_en: Ensures the idempotence of the request. You can generate a parameter value from your client to ensure that the value is unique across different requests. ClientToken supports only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
The modified synchronization objects, in the format of a JSON string. For detailed definitions, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/209545.html.
The original DbList is overwritten by the new DbList. Make sure that the new DbList contains all the objects to be synchronized. Otherwise, synchronization objects may be lost. Modify the objects with caution.
We recommend that you call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/208925.html operation to query the current synchronization objects in advance, and then specify the modified synchronization objects based on your business requirements. For example, if the current objects are Table A and Table B, and you want to add Table C, you must specify Table A, Table B, and Table C in this parameter.
The DbList parameter supports a maximum of 1 MB of data.
If the DbList contains filter conditions, the total length of the DbList (including the filter conditions) can be up to 1 MB.
For distributed tasks (such as data migration or synchronization tasks whose source is PolarDB-X 1.0), the DbList is split based on physical table shards to generate multiple subtasks. The DbList of each subtask supports a maximum of 1 MB of data
parameters.help_zh:
修改后的同步对象，格式为JSON串。详细定义，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/209545.html。
原DbList会被新传入的DbList覆盖，请确保新传入的DbList数据中包含所有需要同步的对象，否则可能会导致同步对象丢失，请谨慎修改。
建议您提前调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/208925.html查询当前同步对象，然后根据业务需要输入修改后的同步对象。例如，当前对象为表A、B，现需要新增对象表C，那么您需要在本参数同时传入表A、B、C。
DbList最多支持传入1 MB的数据。
若DbList中包含过滤条件，则DbList整体（含过滤条件）的长度最大支持1 MB。
分布式任务（例如源端为PolarDB-X 1.0的迁移或同任务）的DbList会根据物理分表进行拆分并生成多个子任务，子任务的DbList最多支持1 MB的数据
parameters.name: db_list

parameters.help_en: The dedicated field for T+1 business and ETL operators
parameters.help_zh: T+1业务专用的字段，ETL算子，为业务专用字段
parameters.name: etl_operator_column_reference

parameters.help_en: Specifies the method to modify the synchronization task. If you do not specify this parameter, the synchronization objects are modified by default. If you set this parameter to UPDATE_RESERVED, the reserved parameters are modified
parameters.help_zh: 指示修改同步任务的方式，不填默认修改同步对象；填写UPDATE_RESERVED为修改预留参数
parameters.name: modify_type_enum

parameters.help_en: The reserved parameters of DTS. The update method is addition rather than overwrite. The format is a MAP JSON string. You can specify this parameter to implement special requirements, such as whether to automatically start the precheck. The usage is similar to the Reserve parameter. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/273111.html
parameters.help_zh: DTS预留参数，更新方式为新增而非覆盖，格式为MAP JSON串，您可以传入本参数实现特殊需求（例如是否自动启动预检查）。使用方法与Reserve参数类似，详情请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/273111.html
parameters.name: reserved

parameters.help_en: The OSS URL of the synchronization file
parameters.name: file_oss_url

parameters.help_en: The name of the table to be filtered
parameters.name: filter_table_name

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform schema migration or initial schema synchronization. Valid values:

true: yes.
false: no
parameters.help_zh:
是否执行库表结构迁移或初始化，取值：

true：是。
false：否
parameters.name: structure_initialization

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform full data migration or initial full data synchronization. Valid values:

true: yes.
false: no
parameters.help_zh:
是否执行全量数据迁移或全量数据初始化，取值：

true：是。
false：否
parameters.name: data_initialization

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform incremental data migration or incremental data synchronization. Valid values:

false: no.
true: yes
parameters.help_zh:
是否执行增量数据迁移或同步，取值：

false：否。
true：是
parameters.name: data_synchronization

parameters.help_en: The ID of the synchronization task. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/209702.html operation to query the ID
parameters.name: dts_job_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether the task is a zero-ETL task. Valid values:
true: yes.
false: no
parameters.help_zh:
是否无感集成（Zero-ETL）任务，取值：
true：是。
false：否
parameters.name: zero_etl_job

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource group
parameters.name: resource_group_id
